summary: GSK plc disclosed via a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) that it agreed to acquire a preclinical trispecific T cell-engager for multiple myeloma from privately held Chimagen Biosciences, gaining full global rights. Total potential value is up to $750 million, comprising an undisclosed upfront fee plus success-based development and commercial milestones; no per-share price applies as the target is private. The programme is expected to enter Phase I in 2027, and closing is subject to customary conditions. Watch milestone-triggered payments, clinical timing and competitive TCE readouts.
